text: Point S is a network of independent tyre and car-maintenance dealers: the group describes itself as 'totally independent' and its members as independent entrepreneurs, some of whom are elected to its boards.
short: Point S is an independent dealer-owned network.

source.name: Point S Group: Our organisation
source.quote: Point S is a group that is totally independent.
source.note: The same page says 'Our members are independent entrepreneurs' and that some members 'have been elected and are involved on our boards'. Page undated beyond a 2024 copyright line.
